December ■ | Noon | Wind: Fierce Gale 
"Claiming the Promised Land!" 
====================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Challenge Cup is finally 
here! If I can take 1st place here, we'll 
get our long-awaited hideout!!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
"As long as you keep your cool, you can 
win this!" That's what Master Navigator 
said! Alright, stay cool, stay cool! Just 
watch me, everyone!!
